text: Commit a shared-tree file by path and by hunk. A whole-file write dropped another lane's uncommitted arena.rs work (294738a77 had to drop those hunks).
git add one path did not scope the commit: the shared index carried another lane's staged console removal into 0a08078c5 under an anim message. Commit with explicit paths.
The AM27 gate read avg_slip (foot offset inside the leg) 0.109355; the pack is local, so the planted foot's world slip is 0.024264 (avg_world_slip). Meter fixed in be75d2c32, 0.08 bar untouched.
